card.name: Subsection numbers in label headings
card.fires_on: The digit after the decimal point in a numbered section heading such as 5.7 or 2.5, right before the subsection title in a drug label. It rarely fires on 'the' in ordinary prose.

modes.label: Subsection digit
modes.description: The digit after the point in a label section number, just before the heading title.

modes.label: Stray 'the' in prose
modes.description: The word 'the' in older narrative text, firing weakly and unrelated to numbering.
